content.comment_body: Hello, When trying to configure a timer based on a counter in [product_name] Soft Comfort, I notice that selecting [product_name] [version_no] FS4 doesn't provide a reference option in the timer settings. However, if I select [product_name] [version_no], the option appears. Can someone assist with this? ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Split from manual parameter change.
